input.subject: Sahab Logistics Est. - documents needed to complete registration
input.body:
Dear Nora,

Thank you for your registration documents. To complete onboarding we need two more items:

1. VAT certificate: the copy received expired on 2026-07-05. Please send a current, valid certificate.
2. Zakat certificate: not received. Please send a copy.

Please reply to this email with the documents attached.

Best regards,
Procurement Team
